title: ziziphus poiretii
intro: Ziziphus poiretii, commonly known as the Chinese jujube, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China and other parts of Asia. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to improve immune function, reduce inflammation, and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Ziziphus poiretii include sedation, anti-anxiety effects, and the ability to lower blood pressure. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
